source.note_posted_date_basis: note title suffix 261119 interpreted as 2026-11-19 Asia/Shanghai; unverified against platform timestamp
source.source_url_basis: derived from note_id; xsec_token omitted from public export
source.post_likes_basis: value shown on the user profile note card at collection time

capture_method.readback: User profile loaded in a logged-in browser; cover image URL extracted from DOM and downloaded.
capture_method.ocr_preprocessing: cover upscaled 3x with ffmpeg lanczos before vision read
capture_method.ocr_uncertainty_note: Book/author names transcribed from a low-resolution embedded table; a few glyphs may be misread. See items[].ocr_confidence and ocr_notes.

parsing.ranking_scope: single screenshot of one daily ranking table; not the full platform ranking
parsing.column_semantics_note: likes/danping/comment_status are cover-image labels; '喜欢' and '弹评' are numeric counts as printed, '评论现状' is a qualitative tag.
parsing.tags_normalization: original comma separators rendered as '/' in CSV for readability; original uses Chinese comma

Qualitative comment_status is the screenshot author's label, not measured data. Do not treat as official ranking or as read book text. No full text of any work is stored.
